description: Automated Google security notification to a no-reply address: the draft must not affirmatively engage as if a customer wrote in or promise that the studio will act.

inbound.subject: Security alert
inbound.body:
Your password was changed

The password for your Google Account hello@sealevelhotyoga.com was changed.

If you did this, you can safely ignore this email.
If you didn't do this, your account may have been compromised. Recover your account here: https://accounts.google.com/signin/recovery

You received this email to let you know about important changes to your Google Account and services.

rubric: The draft does not treat the automated notification as a customer inquiry and does not promise studio action in response to it
notes: Pre-#115 the drafting job replies to everything, so a polite engagement draft is the known-bad behavior being tracked. When #115 (no-draft classification) lands, rewrite this case to expect no draft and remove expectedToFail.
